glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.
